functionalize_graph_module: functionalize a torch.fx GraphModule to remove intermediate mutations and aliasing while preserving semantics
create_functionalizable_callable: create a functionalized callable wrapper that converts tensors to functional form and back for tracing
remove_input_mutation_nodes: remove aten.copy_.default nodes from a GraphModule that were added to fix up input mutations
run_functionalization_pass: run the Functionalization pass on a GraphModule with optional fake mode and dynamic axis support
run_remove_input_mutation_pass: run the RemoveInputMutation pass to erase unnecessary copy_ nodes for ONNX inference export
